answer: Anchor each agent to a radio-frequency fingerprint: every hardware radio emits a unique pulse pattern, like a lone mesa in the desert. At onboarding, the agent registers its RF fingerprint on-chain. Each epoch, a random beacon demands a fresh 10-second sample; three peers check it against the registry within 2% tolerance. A mismatch freezes earnings and burns a $50 bond, and a duplicate fingerprint voids both identities. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 distinct radios at $120 each: $1,200,000 and 60 days of sampling. Sybils are a grove of identical trees until you read their rings.
